hypothesis: Full-source direct handover positives and clean interior negatives identify ordered team-control changes autonomously; symmetric temporal contrast is incremental to instantaneous geometry.
exposure: All3 intensely consumed development matches,shared home team. WMX/WN1 previously exposed, no sealed data opened.
source: IDSSE DFL CC BY4.0 BallStatus/Possession, independently crosschecked; not official target GT
features: Only team-relative distances/counts/speed, visibility, coverage; no absolute coordinates,ball motion,status,phase,event metadata. Team-swap invariant hazard and explicitly antisymmetric direction. context[-.8,0,+.8] vs instant.
labels: directHA first frame +/- .2s; negative alive >1s from ANY transition; D and transition-near others excluded. Direction all alive. All-timeline inference, no anchor required.
sampling: Training only: all positives, negatives on fixed5Hz grid; direction5Hz. Both natural and pre-existing label-independent long occlusion training domains. No validation sampling.
model: StandardScaler+LogisticRegression C1 balanced lbfgs max_iter500 seed115; hazard plus direction per view per fold=12fits. Direction train mirrored and predict antisymmetrized.
decoder: Frozen HC_M3 D AND baseline boundaries. Add only hazard>=.8 and -.8/+ .8s opposite direction each confident>=.8,matching prior baseline. Within baseline spell >=1s until next old boundary; no threshold tuning.
controls: Instant feature ablation; same120/half .5s spacing proposal budget HC/M3 probability difference,R10C2,learned,30s shift,shuffled direction. Full candidate plus shift/shuffle/instant decoded.
gate: >=2/3 natural positive fullspell AND mean>=.02,noDmaskchange,no >.02 short-recall loss; even if pass TRANSFER_NOT_VALIDATED. StageA matched missed-boundary information exceeds bestold in>=2matches.
uncertainty: 1000 match bootstrap seed115;3 reused matches not statistical confirmation
stop: Fail => stop family; no tuning. Keep all receipts.
